response.sql:
WITH sex_counts AS (
    SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS test_count
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY p.SEX
),
averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(test_count) AS avg_count
    FROM sex_counts
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT sc.sex, sc.test_count, a.avg_count
    FROM sex_counts AS sc
    CROSS JOIN averages AS a
    WHERE sc.test_count > a.avg_count
)
SELECT sex,
       test_count,
       CAST(test_count AS REAL) / SUM(test_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_qualifying_total,
       test_count - avg_count AS above_group_average
FROM qualifying;

assumptions.assumption: The per-group average is the arithmetic mean of record counts across sex groups represented among matched laboratory records; the fraction denominator is the total count across qualifying groups.
